start: ^I designed the overall software architecture and dictated the programming standards for my development team.
^Want me to go into more technical detail?
technical_detail: ^I laid out the structural blueprint for the codebase, directly instructing my team members on how to structure their programs, defining interfaces, and enforcing clean development practices.
^In particular, I designed the structure of our scene flows, singleton managers, as well as event-based architecture.
^As the lead developer, I also guided my members on cooperation with unity like separate scenes and prefabs to prevent merge conflicts among team members.
